evidence.quote: For the analysis in §3.3 we install a forward hook on every Gemma4TextRouter module (30 hooks per model). Each hook captures the top\_k\_index tensor, shape [ B · S, k ], from the router output and accumulates a count of (layer, expert) activations.
We repeat for 8 task pools with 50 samples each ( ≈ 400 samples total), capping sequences at 384 tokens.

For the token-level analysis (§3.3.1) we additionally record, for every routing event at layers 11, 12, 13, the input token ID that triggered it, and compute the topn most frequent tokens per (expert, task) bucket.
We run the pipeline on three checkpoints: baseline (Gemma-4-Instruct with extended vocab and mean-initialized new embeddings, no LoRA), CPT-only, and v3.
